title: Strict transform comparison after multiplying a center by a Cartier divisor
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $Z\subseteq S$ be a closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose defining ideal $\mathcal I_Z$ is finite-type quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], and let $D\subseteq S$ be an effective Cartier divisor, i.e. a closed subscheme whose ideal $\mathcal I_D$ is an effective Cartier ideal [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal]. Let $Z_D\subseteq S$ be the closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion] cut out by $\mathcal I_Z\mathcal I_D$, let $b:S'\to S$ be the blow-up in $Z$ and $b_D:S'_D\to S$ the blow-up in $Z_D$ [def-nagata-global-blowup], and fix the isomorphism $\varphi:S'_D\cong S'$ over $S$ of [lemma-nagata-blowup-invertible-factor]. For every morphism $f:X\to S$ [def-pc-scheme] and quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent] having no nonzero local sections supported on $f^{-1}(D)$, the module strict transform of $\mathcal F$ [def-trf-module-strict-transform] relative to the centre $Z$, a quotient of the pullback of $\mathcal F$ to $X\times_S S'$, and its module strict transform relative to the centre $Z_D$, a quotient of the pullback of $\mathcal F$ to $X\times_S S'_D$, correspond under $\mathrm{id}_X\times_S\varphi$ [def-pc-fibre-product]: the two quotients of the pullback of $\mathcal F$ have the same kernel.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-cartier-factor-kernel-transport] to the given $S,Z,D,f,\mathcal F,\varphi$. It supplies the common ambient module $p^*\mathcal F$ on $T=X\times_SS'$, the induced ambient isomorphism, and its two quasi-coherent submodules $\mathcal K,\mathcal K_D$: sections supported over $Z$ and $Z\cup D$, respectively. The same result verifies finite type of the product centre and identifies these submodules with the two quotient kernels, including their inclusions. It remains to show $\mathcal K=\mathcal K_D$.

Choose an affine cover $V=\operatorname{Spec}A$ of $S$ with $\mathcal I_D|_V=(x)$ for a nonzerodivisor $x$ [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal] and $\mathcal I_Z|_V$ given by a finitely generated ideal $I$ [pqf-def-coherent]. Apply [lem-trf-supported-kernel-blowup-charts] to $X_V=f^{-1}(V)\to V$ and $\mathcal F|_{X_V}$. Its charts $W=\operatorname{Spec}(R\otimes_A A[I/a])$, for generators $a$ of $I$ and affine opens $\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq X_V$ with $\mathcal F=\widetilde M$, cover $T_V=T\times_S V$; taking all $V$ covers $T$. On $W$ the ambient module is $\widetilde N$, where $N=M\otimes_A A[I/a]$, and the kernels from step 1 are $\widetilde{\Gamma_{(a)}(N)}$ and $\widetilde{\Gamma_{(xa)}(N)}$, including their inclusions.

Let $m\in M$ satisfy $x^nm=0$, with $x$ acting through $A\to R$. Its image in $M_x$ is zero, so the corresponding section of $\mathcal F$ over $\operatorname{Spec}R$ vanishes off $f^{-1}(D)$. The hypothesis makes this section zero. Thus $\Gamma_{(x)}(M)=0$ as an $A$-module; regularity of $x$ is needed only in $A$, where step 2 supplies it. Each chosen $a$ belongs to $I$. Apply [lem-trf-strict-transform-affine-torsion-comparison] to obtain $\Gamma_{(a)}(M\otimes_AA[I/a])=\Gamma_{(xa)}(M\otimes_AA[I/a])$. The identifications including inclusions in step 2 give $\mathcal K|_W=\mathcal K_D|_W$ inside the same $\widetilde N$.

For any open $H\subseteq T$, membership of a section of $p^*\mathcal F$ in either kernel is local on the cover $H\cap W$. The equalities in step 3 therefore give $\mathcal K(H)=\mathcal K_D(H)$, hence equality of the included subsheaves. Under the isomorphism $\mathrm{id}_X\times_S\varphi$ of step 1 [def-pc-fibre-product], these are the two strict-transform quotient kernels. The quotients consequently have the same kernel as asserted.
